text:
Alice Nguyen: heading out for my oncall shift in 30m — doing a quick pre-handoff. checklist: runbooks updated? VPN creds for nonprod? pager token valid? access to runbook editor? any known risks for this window? 

Roberto Diaz: thanks — re: VPN creds, last week we rotated the nonprod VPN cert. If you haven't pulled the new profile, run:
```
aws ssm get-parameter --name /infra/vpn/nonprod/profile --with-decryption --query Parameter.Value --output text > ~/.config/vpn/nonprod.ovpn
```
I also posted the profile in last week's infra-change thread.

Carla Mendes: I updated the runbook at https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall-nonprod (minor clarifications on cache flush). Also added a short checklist for pager token refresh (see section 'Pager tokens').

Alice Nguyen: cool, linking that now. @oncall-bot can you run the preflight checks (runbooks present, pager routing, pager token TTL)?

oncall-bot: preflight results for thread 1773519876:
- runbook: found (version 2026-03-16T18:10Z)
- pager routing: default -> SRE escalation OK
- pager token TTL: expires in 2d (recommend rotate if >72h window)
- nonprod VPN profile: present
Status: WARNING — pager token < 72h remaining :rotating_light:

SRE Rotation: I can pick this up if you need to rotate the token. Steps are in the runbook; quick snippet:
```
pagerctl token rotate --service redwood-nonprod --env nonprod --notify oncall
```
You'll need ksm access.

Alice Nguyen: thanks. I don't want to interrupt prod pager routing. Roberto can you help rotate and test? I'll stay available for 30m post-rotate to validate alerts.

Roberto Diaz: on it. Rotating now, will post verification steps.

Roberto Diaz: rotated token, tested alert path with `pagerctl test-alert --to-team SRE` — alert delivered. Marking as done and adding note to runbook.

Alice Nguyen: great. Quick note — we have a scheduled deploy in nonprod at 02:00 UTC, may see a brief spike in error rate on the /ingest queue. Keep eyes on ingest-worker errors (dashboard: https://dashboards.redwood/ingest-errors). If anything >5% error rate, page and escalate to eng-runtime.

Carla Mendes: acked, I added that deploy note to the runbook and a watch threshold in alerts (ingest-errors > 5% for 5m).

Alice Nguyen: thanks team — handing off now. @SRE Rotation take the shift; I left a short set of sticky notes in the runbook under 'handed-by Alice N'.

SRE Rotation: taking handoff, thanks Alice. ping here for anything urgent. :thumbsup:
